en: New version trial: the first ten minutes
Get through the mist and take Pok to South Street
zh_TW: 穿過毒霧，把波克帶到南街

en: The healing stopped when you left the mist. Step back in to check
zh_TW: 離開毒霧，回血就停了。再踏回去確認一次

en: Try the Mist Serpent Venom (or keep it for later)
zh_TW: 試用霧蛇毒劑（也可以先收著）

en: Head for the freight lift to the underground market

zh_TW: 【逆轉體質已啟動】中毒 → 持續回血

en: Effect: Poisoned for 20 seconds. Label: NOT FOR DRINKING
zh_TW: 效果：中毒，持續 20 秒。瓶上寫：不可飲用

en: You're at full health, so you won't see any effect. Drink it anyway?
zh_TW: 現在滿血，看不出效果。還是要喝嗎？

en: To be continued: the underground market
You still owe us our pay!

zh_TW: 諾恩，這句可以等一下再喊。

en: The warmth stopped when the mist thinned... Step back in. Just to be sure.
zh_TW: 霧散了，溫熱感也停了……再踏回去一次。確認一下就好。

en: I think today might not be that unlucky after all.
zh_TW: 我想，我今天可能沒那麼倒楣。

en: Who brought poison into a residential street?
The guy who just ran off!
Take the injured man inside! ...You too. Get in.
Don't hit its chest yet. That's where the poison sprays from.
zh_TW: 先別打牠胸口。那是噴毒的地方。

en: (Step into the mist and show her the closing wound)
zh_TW: （走進毒霧，讓她看手上正在收口的傷）

en: Did that thing hit your head? ...Fine. Prove it while we fight.
zh_TW: 你被打昏頭了？……算了，邊打邊證明。

en: Its right knee. Take it down.
If you're scared of pain, stop running into poison.
zh_TW: 會怕痛就別一直往毒裡跑。

en: Two sealed bottles left. "Mist Serpent Venom. Poisoned, 20 seconds."
zh_TW: 還有兩瓶封好的。「霧蛇毒劑：中毒，持續二十秒。」

en: Breathing it in worked. Would a sip be any different?
zh_TW: 剛才只是吸到霧。喝一點會不會不一樣？

en: So you're not immune to poison.
From what I can tell, poison helps me heal.
zh_TW: 目前看起來，毒會幫我恢復。

en: Then don't drink random things. You've checked this one. Get the others tested first.
zh_TW: 那就先別亂喝。這瓶你確認過，其他的先找人驗。

en: Fine. Anything else, get it tested first.
Red left this in my keeping. Pok says it's what he owed you.
zh_TW: 雷德寄存的。欠你們的那份，波克認出來了。

en: Only half. The broken crates, we'll settle later.
zh_TW: 只有一半。那些打壞的木箱之後算。

en: Which is why I'm going after the man who ran.
This batch was supposed to be destroyed. The report says monsters hit the shipment.
zh_TW: 這批藥應該已經銷毀了。報告上寫，運送途中遭怪物襲擊。

en: Red asked about the freight lift to the underground market this morning. They've been taking in loads of goods that can't pass certification.
zh_TW: 雷德早上問過地下市場的貨梯。那裡最近收一大批不能過認證的東西。

en: Poisonous ones. Ones that make your limbs stop listening. Ones that sap your strength. Nobody normal buys them.
zh_TW: 有毒的、會讓人手腳不聽話的、戴上就沒力氣的。正常客人不會買。

en: Like you're about to get a free meal.
Partners? You find evidence. I find my pay.
zh_TW: 合作嗎？妳找證據，我找工錢。

en: Deal. Bring your own drinks. Nothing goes in my canteen.
zh_TW: 可以。飲料自己帶，不准放進我的水壺。
